opening_condition: One identity-opening authorization may be issued only after the exact confirmatory character-mask survivor geometry reruns the frozen Study B qualification at alpha=0.025 and passes every Type-I, power and numerical gate.

genetic_response.marker: mitochondrial COI/COX1 family under the inherited exact alias parser
genetic_response.panel_selection: same response-blind one-panel-per-species rule inherited from fresh phylogatR: most exact unique localities, then more aligned headers, then lexicographic locus identifier
genetic_response.sequence_pair_distance: uncorrected p-distance = canonical A/C/G/T mismatches / jointly canonical columns
genetic_response.locality_pair_distance: arithmetic mean across every valid cross-locality sequence-pair p-distance
genetic_response.edge_response: locality-pair p-distance on the unchanged frozen density-scaled kNN edge
genetic_response.source_training_response: post-IBD turnover rank orthogonalized against within-source edge-length rank
genetic_response.source_to_target_score: T_st = Spearman correlation between source-only TTF field prediction and target post-IBD turnover

relational_model.covariance: two-way source/target cluster-robust sandwich with dyad intersection subtraction and finite-cluster corrections

program_transition.positive: close v0.3 as DETECTED_B; Study C remains unopened
program_transition.qualified_null: record B qualified null and proceed to already-frozen Study C
program_transition.technical_or_gate_failure_before_opening: NOT_EVALUABLE_B; proceed to already-frozen Study C
program_transition.post_opening_execution_failure: freeze failure receipt; no result-selection rerun or estimator change; program handling must distinguish technical incompletion from a biological null

one_shot_rules: Do not alter species, dyads, R_env, controls, PCA/KDE representation, genetic response definition, IBD residualization, bandwidth, prior, segment points, covariance, alpha, or decision rule after identity opening.
Do not test an alternative environmental metric, taxonomic subgroup, threshold, or interaction as a replacement primary analysis.
The S1-S3 outcomes cannot be rewritten by Study B.
